title: Harry_Potter

scene.description: The atmosphere is eerie as the wind howls around the Shrieking Shack. The moon is hidden behind clouds, casting a mysterious glow over the scene. A secret meeting is about to take place between two key characters.

player.name: Luna Lovegood
player.position: Standing near the entrance of the Shrieking Shack, looking around warily.
player.states: Luna is feeling a mix of anticipation and caution, eager to discuss the latest developments but aware of the risks involved in meeting in such a secluded place.
player.description: Luna is a quirky and insightful student, known for her unique perspective on the magical world. She is wearing her characteristic radish earrings and is excited about the upcoming meeting.

target.name: Neville Longbottom
target.position: Hiding behind a large rock, keeping an eye out for any sign of trouble.
target.states: Neville is nervous but determined, ready to support Luna and the plan they have put in place.
target.description: Neville is a brave and loyal friend to Harry Potter and his classmates. He has been practicing his magical skills and is ready to contribute to their cause.

action_reference: Neville whispers to Luna, reminding her to keep her voice down so as not to attract unwanted attention.

turns.player_dialogue: Remind me, where are we right now, and what time of day is it?
turns.npc_dialogue: We’re in the Shrieking Shack, Luna, and it’s late evening. We need to be really careful. I mean, it’s not exactly the safest place, is it? Just… let’s keep our wands ready, alright? I don’t want to end up like last time. I know we can do this, though. Together.
